articles.title: Letter: The Book Exchange Box on Dover Place Needs Attention
body: To the editor: I have lived on Dover Place for 14 years, and I want to say what a difference the Millrace Library branch has made. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Please keep the book exchange box in the budget. Many of us on Dover Place use it every week. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the April meeting.
Elias Sandoval, Upper Commons

articles.title: Ida Tiernan, 72, Tailor
articles.deck: Friends remember Ida Tiernan for the many years of service to Stonebridge.
body: Born in Stonebridge in the years after the war, Ida Tiernan spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Ida Tiernan died in September at home on Nash Drive, at the age of 72. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Upper Commons Historical Society in his or her name.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Stonebridge.
